method.psd: Duration-weighted stable segments; Welch 4096; linear detrend; 50% overlap
method.line_bands: 50 +/-1 Hz; harmonics every 50 Hz, 100-450 Hz +/-1 Hz; includes physiological power inside these bands
method.model: Refit EMG008-only baseline with fixed training settings and five seeds; no EMG012 used in transfer training or scaling
method.within: Complete labeled bouts held out in outer StratifiedGroupKFold; internal MLP early stopping uses random training windows
method.limitations: Overlapping windows are correlated. Three action bouts per class, one wearing session. Seed SD is not a confidence interval. PC1 of differential channels is shared variance, not a direct common-mode voltage measurement.
